Garner Health is transforming the U.S. healthcare system by using clinical metrics, healthcare data, incentives, and AI to improve care and reduce costs. The Associate Software Engineer will build, optimize, and maintain software systems, collaborate across disciplines, protect user privacy and security, and participate in code reviews.

Required
• Recent graduate (Spring 2026) or currently enrolled student (expected graduation of Fall 2026 or Spring 2027), with a Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science or a related STEM field
• Solid CS fundamentals with experience in front-end (JavaScript, React) or back-end (Python, Node.js) technologies
• A track record of shipping high-quality features through internships or personal projects
• Strong technical writing, analytical, and communication skills
• Excited to join a high-performing, mission-driven team that values urgency, accountability, and honest feedback
• A desire to do work that matters: and to be held to a high standard while doing it. You're energized by a mission with measurable outcomes, not just good intentions. You engage with AI tools as part of how you do your best work, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes that matter beyond your team's metrics
Please note: we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time
Preferred
• Experience with a database system such as PostgreSQL or ElasticSearch; familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Docker) is a plus
• Exposure to building with AI coding agents (we use Claude Code) is a plus
